title: TeamTalk Music Player v2.2.1
changelog: "Major Playback Speed Optimization: 'p' (play/search), 'n' (skip), and 'b' (prev) commands respond near-instantly with parallel stream extraction, negative caching, and background adjacent prefetching."
"Non-Blocking Neural Edge TTS: Song announcements never delay playback. Added 'tts_wait_ms' timeout budget and studio-mastered audio caching in downloads/tts_cache."
"Intelligent yt-dlp Client Selection: Prioritizes fast stream clients (android, tv_embedded) with seamless automatic fallback to yt-dlp default (Samsung TV, Web) when JS challenges are required."
"Embedded QuickJS Runtime & yt-dlp-ejs: Bundled qjs.exe and yt-dlp-ejs solver for 100% self-contained offline execution of YouTube JavaScript challenges."
"Mid-Track Stream Recovery: Automatically recovers and resumes playback from the exact second if a stream gets interrupted or encounters HTTP 403."
"Config Preserving Architecture: Atomic read-merge-write safety across global_settings.json and servers.json ensuring custom settings are never lost."
